i1.title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Spiced cardamom and cumin over rose and iris, with vanilla and amber.

Rasasi Daarej Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml is a warm, spicy oriental. Cardamom, cumin and artemisia open with spice, a powdery heart of rose and iris follows, and it settles into a rich base of vanilla, tonka, amber, sandalwood, patchouli and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Cardamom, Cumin, Artemisia
  • Heart: Rose, Iris
  • Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Rasasi
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Spicy · Oriental · Powdery
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A spicy opening of cardamom and cumin
  • A powdery heart of rose and iris
  • A rich base of vanilla, tonka and amber
  • Warm, distinguished character

FAQ

What does Daarej Pour Homme smell like?

Cardamom, cumin and artemisia first, then rose and iris, finishing with vanilla, tonka bean, amber, sandalwood, patchouli and musk.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.
